# Proofday
> Proofday sells a $149 Website Launch Check for small owner-led web agencies and freelancers launching client websites.

## Offer
- Customer submits a URL (up to 10 public pages they own or are authorized to test) and a note on what visitors should be able to do.
- Delivered: owner summary (Pass / Needs fixes / Fail verdict, top 5 issues in plain English) plus developer tickets (steps, expected vs actual, fix), full-page mobile (390x844) and desktop (1366x768) screenshots, and one retest. Covers navigation/broken links, mobile display problems, missing content, console errors and observable load issues.
- Not included: hosting, repairs, unlimited support, calls, security certification, or any promise that every issue is found. Untestable features (logins, forms, payments, email) are marked "not tested".

## Links
- Home: https://proofday.vercel.app/
- Sample report (PDF): https://proofday.vercel.app/sample-report.pdf
- Free quick preview (one page, HTML-only): https://proofday.vercel.app/scan

## Guides
- Website launch checklist (36 pre-launch checks, 14 automated by Proofday): https://proofday.vercel.app/website-launch-checklist
- Webflow site QA before launch (23-step checklist): https://proofday.vercel.app/webflow-site-qa-before-launch

## Facts
- Price: $149 USD, one site, one retest. Ordering/checkout not live yet.
- Not tested: form submissions, payments, logins, email delivery, Safari/Firefox rendering, real devices.
